R1708.database_conflict: UniProt Q6C3Z9 calls the protein acetyl-CoA hydrolase with EC 3.1.2.1, but marks protein existence and catalytic details as homology/by-similarity evidence.
R1708.function_evidence_interpretation: experimentally supported in the tested Yarrowia system
R1708.functional_evidence: Crude-extract activity favored acetate:succinate CoA transfer over hydrolase activity, and Ylach deletion strongly reduced acetate formation; these experiments support the function in the tested engineered Y. lipolytica background.
R1708.localization_evidence: The mitochondrial assignment is pathway-level and condition-specific; no direct protein-localization experiment was verified, so localization remains unverified/conflicting.

R2004.search_interpretation: Exact UniProt, KEGG, NCBI Protein, PubMed, and Rhea searches found no direct Yarrowia assignment. Zero hits mean no evidence was found by these bounded queries, not that the activity is biologically absent.
